en-US: Preview attached PDFs directly in notes with continuous scrolling, zoom, fullscreen, download, external-open controls, and a compact fallback for document-heavy workflows.
Browse PDF resources visually with lazily rendered first-page thumbnails in the Assets pane, while failed or unsupported documents fall back predictably.
Keep the intended editor location stable when several images are pasted rapidly.
Make iOS download requirements clearer and improve the visual hierarchy of platform download actions.
Align editor placeholder typography with the surrounding writing experience.
Use GHCR as the documented official image source for more predictable Docker self-hosting updates.
zh-CN: 在笔记内直接预览 PDF，支持连续滚动、缩放、全屏、下载、外部打开，并可折叠为紧凑附件卡片，改善文档密集型工作流。
在资源库中通过懒加载的 PDF 首页缩略图直观浏览文档；渲染失败或不受支持时会稳定回退。
快速连续粘贴多张图片时，编辑器会稳定保持预期的插入位置。
更清楚地提示 iOS 下载所需条件，并优化各平台下载操作的视觉层级。
统一编辑器占位文字与整体写作界面的排版表现。
将 GHCR 明确为官方镜像来源，使 Docker 自托管更新路径更清晰、可预期。
